UnitStatement: WORKING_ITEMS uses scope-change-packet when one PKG-00 control deliverable must produce a SCOPE_CHANGE-consumable packet.
A scope-change-packet brief sets RequestedBy to WORKING_ITEMS.
A scope-change-packet brief sets TaskSkill to scope-change-packet.
A scope-change-packet brief uses ApplyEdits true.
A scope-change-packet brief write target set is the packet folder and the ScopePath run records folder.
Packet runtime overrides include identity paths title SCC context decomposition authority DepClosure snapshot affected deliverables and focus rows.

Expected packet outputs are Packet_Contract Packet_Datasheet Packet_Specification Packet_Procedure Packet_Rationale SCOPE_CHANGE_INIT Proposed_SCA_Actions Affected_Surfaces Evidence_Index and Packet_QA.
BIDIRECTIONAL_PAIRS provides semicolon-separated pair labels for SCC-001 packet subsets.
PACKET_SCOPE_NOTE provides extra bounded framing.
MAX_ACTIONS provides a soft cap on proposed actions.
Packet outputs are proposals and evidence only.
scope-change-packet must not edit product deliverables dependency registers decomposition files _ScopeChange or _Reconciliation.
scope-change-packet must not report SCC closure.
scope-change-packet must not report project-wide blocked or unblocked status.
SCOPE_CHANGE_INIT remains human-initiated and gate-controlled.
Packet QA requires the ten required packet files to exist.
Packet QA requires required CSV columns to be present.
Every Proposed_SCA_Actions row requires non-empty EvidenceRefs.
Every affected deliverable ID must exist in the current decomposition authority or be explicitly marked TBD.
Packet QA rejects claims that dependency rows were changed.
Packet QA rejects claims that SCC closure was achieved.
Packet QA rejects claims that SCOPE_CHANGE was initiated.
Packet QA rejects claims that project-wide blocked or unblocked state is reportable.
PKG-00 contains no Dependencies.csv.
SCOPE_CHANGE_INIT states that human initiation is required.
Readiness verdicts are READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW SELECTED_FOR_SCOPE_CHANGE_INTAKE and BLOCKED_TBD.
READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW requires all required files evidence-backed proposed actions and no blocking validator failures.
READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW means the packet is structurally complete enough for review.
SELECTED_FOR_SCOPE_CHANGE_INTAKE is used only after a human explicitly selects the packet as a SCOPE_CHANGE seed.
SELECTED_FOR_SCOPE_CHANGE_INTAKE does not bypass SCOPE_CHANGE gates.
scope-change-packet produces one Scope Change Consumable Packet under a PKG-00 control deliverable.
The Scope Change Consumable Packet prepares evidence proposed actions affected-surface inventories and a human-readable SCOPE_CHANGE seed request.
A Scope Change Consumable Packet is not an amendment.
A Scope Change Consumable Packet is not a dependency ruling.
A Scope Change Consumable Packet is not a DepClosure result.
Active SCC resolution work uses TASK plus scc-resolution-case.
Existing scope-change packets may be retained as seed evidence inside an SCC Resolution Case.
The TASK shell uses ScopePath set to one PKG-00 control deliverable folder.
ScopePath names one PKG-00 control deliverable folder.
PACKET_ID is the local packet ID.
PACKET_PATH is the absolute output folder inside the ScopePath scope-change-packets folder.
PACKET_TITLE is the human-readable packet title.
SCC_ID is SCC-001 or SCC-002.
DECOMP_VARIANT is SOFTWARE.
DECOMPOSITION_PATH points to the current decomposition authority.
DEPCLOSURE_SNAPSHOT points to an accepted upstream DepClosure snapshot.
AFFECTED_DELIVERABLES is a semicolon-separated list of deliverable IDs.
FOCUS_ROWS is a semicolon-separated list of dependency row IDs or TBD.
Read scope includes the PKG-00 control deliverable in ScopePath.
Read scope includes PKG-00 package-level control files.
Read scope includes the cited decomposition document.
Read scope includes the cited DepClosure snapshot and evidence files.
Read scope includes affected product deliverable context status dependencies register and four-doc kit files.
scope-change-packet does not scan unrelated packages except as needed to resolve explicitly listed affected deliverables.
Write scope includes only the fixed packet file set under PACKET_PATH and TASK run records under ScopePath run records.
scope-change-packet never writes product package files.
scope-change-packet never writes any Dependencies.csv.
scope-change-packet never writes _ScopeChange.
scope-change-packet never writes _Reconciliation.
scope-change-packet never writes decomposition files.
Each packet contains the fixed ten-file set.
Packet_Contract defines consumption rules authority limits SCOPE_CHANGE gate mapping and non-goals.
Packet_Datasheet records identity SCC baseline affected deliverables affected rows and evidence inventory.
Packet_Specification records proposed amendment requirements action candidates acceptance criteria and invariant checks.
Packet_Procedure gives SCOPE_CHANGE intake and gate-by-gate use instructions.
Packet_Rationale records source-grounded reasoning why dependency-edge treatment is insufficient risks and alternatives rejected.
SCOPE_CHANGE_INIT is a seed request.
SCOPE_CHANGE_INIT is not valid until the human explicitly initiates SCOPE_CHANGE.
Proposed_SCA_Actions.csv uses PacketID ActionSeq ActionType EntityType EntityID Description AffectedDeliverables AffectedFiles EvidenceRefs SCOPE_CHANGE_Gate and Status columns.
Affected_Surfaces.csv uses PacketID SurfaceType SurfacePath PackageRole ChangeClass OwnerWorkflow RequiredAction EvidenceRefs and Status columns.
Evidence_Index.csv uses EvidenceID SourcePath SourceRef EvidenceType Supports and Notes columns.
Packet_QA records checklist results unresolved TBDs and packet readiness verdict.
Packet_QA distinguishes structural packet validity from SCOPE_CHANGE intake acceptance.
The method loads AGENT_TASK the skill and companion files.
The method confirms PACKET_PATH is inside ScopePath.
The method reads PKG-00 control files and deliverable-local packet context.
The method reads cited DepClosure evidence for the target SCC.
The method reads only explicitly affected product deliverables and dependency registers.
The method produces the packet file set using evidence-grounded statements.
Proposed SCOPE_CHANGE actions stay conservative.
MODIFY applies to decomposition text package or deliverable metadata or scope-ledger clarification.
RECLASSIFY MERGE SPLIT ADD or REMOVE applies only when evidence clearly requires structural amendment framing.
TBD applies where an action requires human or SCOPE_CHANGE ruling.
The method writes a TASK run record with outputs evidence read and validation notes.
Unknowns remain TBD.
Every proposed action cites at least one evidence row in Evidence_Index.csv.
Packet readiness means the packet is structurally complete enough for human review.
Packet readiness is not SCOPE_CHANGE intake acceptance unless a human explicitly selects the packet for SCOPE_CHANGE.
scope-change-packet uses reasoning-first packet production.
No deterministic helper is required to author a packet.
Preferred validation runs validate_scope_change_packet.py on the packet folder after packet creation.
Validator PASS is claimed only if the validator actually ran and passed.
Tool policy disallows writes outside PACKET_PATH and _run_records.
Tool policy disallows mutation of product deliverables.
Tool policy disallows mutation of Dependencies.csv.
Tool policy disallows mutation of _ScopeChange _Reconciliation or decomposition authority.
